rank_math.description: Window crank repair and window hardware repair across the GTA. Stripped cranks, broken operators, and seized hinges on casement and awning windows. Same or next day.

fields.hero_h1: Window Crank Repair in Toronto and the GTA
fields.hero_subhead: Stripped crank, broken operator, or a casement that will not close? We repair the hardware, not the whole window, across the GTA.
fields.overview_body:
When a casement or awning window will not open, close, or seal, the glass is fine, the hardware has worn out. SolidGuard does window crank repair across Toronto and the GTA: stripped crank handles, broken operators, and seized hinges. A quick window hardware repair restores the window for far less than replacing it.

We carry common operators and parts for most makes, so casement window repair and window hinge repair are often done in a single visit. Cranks, operators, hinges, and locks, we match the part and set the window so it cranks smoothly and closes tight against the weatherseal again.
fields.repairfirst_body: A window that will not crank rarely needs replacing. The operator or hinge is the worn part, and that is what we fix, so you keep the window you have.

faqs.question: My window crank spins but the window will not move. Can you fix it?
faqs.answer: Yes. That is usually a stripped operator gear. A window crank repair replaces the operator and the window opens and closes properly again.

faqs.question: Do you repair casement and awning windows?
faqs.answer: Yes. Casement window repair and awning hardware are common jobs for us, including operators, hinges, handles, and locks.

faqs.question: Do I need a whole new window?
faqs.answer: Almost never. The glass is fine and the hardware is the worn part. A window hardware repair is far less than a replacement window.

faqs.question: Can you match hardware for an older window?
faqs.answer: Usually yes. We carry common operators and parts for most makes and can source older or specialty hardware when needed.

faqs.question: My window will not seal shut and it is drafty. Is that hardware?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. A worn operator or bent hinge stops the sash pulling tight against the weatherseal. Repairing the hardware usually fixes the draft.

faqs.question: How fast can you come out?
faqs.answer: Same or next day across most of the GTA, and many crank and hardware jobs are done in that first visit.
